
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19967057" title="发布于 2026-05-03 18:26">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript之eval函数详解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行库，内置的eval函数可动态执行字符串脚本，在python脚本中对应的是exec函数。</p>
<h1>一、示例</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Script().Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n=10;eval(\"n+20\")</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 30</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Script().Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n=10;eval(\"n+20\")</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, ECompileMode.All)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 30</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Script().Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n=10;var s=\"n+20\";eval(s)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 30</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Script().Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n=10;var s=\"n+20\";eval(s)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, ECompileMode.All)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 20</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Script().Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n=10;eval(\"n+=20\");n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 30</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Script().Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n=10;eval(\"n+=20\");n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, ECompileMode.All)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 30</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Script().Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n=10;var s=\"n+=20\";eval(s);n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 30</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Script().Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int n=10;var s=\"n+=20\";eval(s);n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, ECompileMode.All)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 10</span></pre>
</div>
<p>为什么第4行输出结果是20，第8行输出结果是10呢？我们来看一下eval函数的运行机制。</p>
<h1>二、运行机制</h1>
<p>eval函数实际是调用Script中的<em><strong>Eval</strong></em>方法，使用脚本中的当前编译上下文<em><strong>BuildContext</strong></em>、数据上下文<em><strong>ScriptContext</strong></em>和编译选项<em><strong>BuildOptions</strong></em>；</p>
<p>我们把当前脚本当作主干A，把eval中的脚本当作分支A1，分支A1是共享主干A中的上下文和编译选项；</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202605/417450-20260503182542609-2112527070.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>1、在解析执行模式下，可以使用和修改主干A中的变量，分支A1中自定义的变量也可以传递到主干A中。</p>
<p>2、在编译执行模式下又有所不同，分2种场景：</p>
<p>1）参数为字符串常量，此时会将字符串的解析结果合并到主干A中进行编译和执行，不会产生分支A1。</p>
<p>2）参数为变量，由于编译期间无法确定变量的值，无法合并到主干A中进行编译，此时会产生分支A1进行单独编译执行，分支A1只能共享主干A的变量定义，无法共享赋值语句，所以分支A1中的变量n为0，且修改变量值也无法同步到主干中。</p>
<p>eval函数详细实现请参考源码中的<em><strong>AScript.Functions.EvalFunction</strong></em>。</p>
<h1>三、总结</h1>
<p>如果eval中要使用主干中的变量值，请使用解析执行模式或者参数为字符串常量。</p>
<hr>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>AScript开源地址：https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</p>
